title: Every Single Day
description: Every single day is a new day!
body:
### 为我的世界添加了新的系统：每日运势！ Adds a new system for Minecraft: Every Single Day!
游戏内每天早晨都会赋予玩家一正一负的随机效果，并于聊天栏显示具体信息。 Every morning in the game, players will be given a random effect of one positive and one negative, and specific information will be displayed in the chat bar. 效果一览 Effect overview | 宜/ Suitable for | 效果/ Effect | ID | | --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------ | | 种植 / Farming | 作物生长速度+50% / +50% crop growth speed | `farming` | | 战斗 / Combat | 攻击力+20% / +20% attack damage | `combat` | | 运动 / Sprinting | 移动速度+30% / +30% movement speed | `speed` | | 休养 / Resting | 生命恢复+2倍 / +100% health regeneration | `health` | | 碰运气 / Gambling | 幸运效果+钓鱼运气 / Bonus luck & fishing fortune | `luck` | | 涅槃 / Rebirth | 死亡时重生并爆炸 / Respawn on death with an explosion | `phoenix` | | 收集 / Collecting | 自动吸引附近物品 / Auto-attract nearby items | `magnet` | | 熬夜 / Staying-up | 永久夜视效果 / Permanent night vision | `night_vision` | | 玩火 / Pyromania | 免疫火焰伤害 / Immune to fire damage | `fire_immunity` | | 潜水 / Diving | 水下呼吸+游泳速度 / Underwater breathing & faster swim | `water_breathing` | | 战斗 / Vampire | 攻击敌人时回复生命 / Heal when attacking foes | `vampire` | | 寻宝 / Treasure hunting | 发现隐藏宝箱和稀有矿石 / Reveal hidden chests & rare ores | `treasure_hunter` | | 时间掌控 / Time control | 时间流逝速度减半 / Halve the speed of time flow | `time_master` | | 偷袭 / Ambush | 潜行时隐身+速度提升 / Invisibility + speed while sneaking | `shadow_step` | | 战斗 / Combat | 周期性获得随机元素保护 / Periodically gain random elemental shield | `elemental_shield` | | 不宜/ Unsuitable for | 效果/ Effect | ID | | --------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | ------------------ | | 下水 / Entering water | 在水中速度-50% / –50% speed in water | `water` | | 运动 / Sprinting | 饥饿速度+2倍 / Hunger depletes 2× faster | `hunger` | | 战斗 / Combat | 攻击力-20% / –20% attack damage | `weakness` | | 运动 / Sprinting | 移动速度-20% / –20% movement speed | `slowness` | | 下矿 / Mining | 挖掘速度-30% / –30% mining speed | `mining_fatigue` | | 碰运气 / Gambling | 幸运效果-钓鱼运气差 / Reduced luck & poor fishing fortune | `unluck` | | 死亡 / Death | 死亡时产生爆炸 / Explode upon death | `explosive_death` | | 晒太阳 / Sunbathing | 白天在阳光下持续受伤 / Continuous damage under daylight | `sun_allergy` | | 外出 / Going outside | 持续发出声音吸引怪物 / Constant noise draws monsters | `noise_maker` | | 外出 / Going outside | 方向感错乱（视角旋转） / Disorienting view spin | `confusion` | | 外出 / Going outside | 持续吸引闪电 / Constantly attract lightning | `storm_maker` | **目前支持的版本：** Fabric 1.20.1（需要 Fabric Loader 0.16.14 以及上版本，Fabric API任意版本）。 (requires Fabric Loader 0.16.14
